answer: One concrete defense is vertex-disjoint attestation paths. A new identity must gather endorsements along several routes to trusted seed nodes, routes that share no intermediate vertex, so no single clique can vouch for a fake. Each endorser risks its own standing if the identity later cheats, and endorsements expire each epoch. A Sybil farmer faces a gale of costs: every clone needs its own independent paths, each crossing strangers who will not sign for a face they have never seen, so the door stays open to real ties yet umber-dark to ghosts with no history.
